request_json.title: Unapproved Alder Relay training slide correction
request_json.text: Training slide 17 was labelled 'Alder Relay 2.4: three attempts everywhere'. Editorial correction dated 2028-02-10: the slide copied the old 1.8 quickstart and was never approved as the 2.4 retry policy. Do not use it to determine 2.4 defaults or a cluster's effective value. Use the approved 2.4 normative policy together with the signed fleet configuration register.
